parts.name: Root
parts.description: The toggle button. It makes a native <button type="button"> element with aria-pressed. It shows its selected state and its interaction state in data attributes.

props.name: value
props.description: The stable identifier, which the component puts on the button. In a `ToggleGroup.Root`, the selection needs it. It does not show the selected state.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The selected state at the start, for when the component controls the state. In a `ToggleGroup`, the component ignores it.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected state. You can bind it. When your own code controls the state, `undefined` becomes `false`. In a `ToggleGroup`, the component ignores it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the selected state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the interaction with the toggle and removes it from the focus order.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button. As a snippet, it can receive the current render state, for example `selected`.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-grouped
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is inside a `ToggleGroup.Root`.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the toggle.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer or the keyboard presses the toggle.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-unselected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is not selected.
